settings.title: Choose & pay
settings.text: Pick a package and pay securely at checkout. You get an order email straight away with a link to your project form.

settings.title: Project form
settings.text: Tell us about your business, style and pages, and share your logo and photos. Your timeline starts when this is complete.

settings.title: Design
settings.text: We send a design direction for your homepage. You give feedback in one consolidated round.

settings.title: Build & set up
settings.text: We build every page, set up products, payments and shipping, and test on phones, tablets and desktops. About 10 business days for Essential, 3–4 weeks for 3D Experience, 4–5 weeks for Business Launch.

settings.title: Review & launch
settings.text: You review, we apply your revisions, then we launch together and hand over with training.
A simple, written process. You always know what happens next and what we need from you.
settings.heading: From checkout to opening day.

settings.text: Optional monthly plans for after your project. Cancel anytime. Shopify handles hosting and security, so you only pay for real human checks and edits.
settings.note: Work outside your plan is quoted first at $65/hour. Plans don't include redesigns, new features or ad management.

settings.title: Fixed prices
settings.text: Published up front. No hourly surprises.

settings.title: Bilingual
settings.text: We build and support in English and Spanish.

settings.title: You own it
settings.text: Your store, domain and content are yours, and every account and licence is in your name.

settings.title: No passwords
settings.text: We work through Shopify collaborator access.

settings.a: You pay the full package price online at checkout with card, Shop Pay, Apple Pay or Google Pay. Prices are in USD.
Right after checkout you get a link to a short project form. Your timeline starts once the form and your files (logo, photos, product info) are in. We confirm your start date within 1 business day.

settings.q: Do I need a Shopify plan?
settings.a: Yes. Your store runs on your own Shopify account and plan, which you pay Shopify for directly. If you don't have one yet, we help you open it. Domains, paid apps and premium themes are also paid by you.

settings.q: What counts as a revision round?
settings.a: One consolidated list of changes on the current design. A completely new direction is a new project. Extra rounds can be added at our hourly rate.
Yes. The 3D Experience package includes a real-time WebGL scene that visitors can interact with, plus a lightweight fallback for older phones so the site stays fast.
No one honestly can. We build a fast, trustworthy, properly configured store and help you prepare marketing. Results depend on your product, pricing and promotion.

Business Launch includes setting up your Instagram, Facebook and TikTok business profiles, connecting the Meta and TikTok pixels and preparing one ad campaign draft (not launched). Running ads and the ad budget are separate.
Sí. We work with clients in the US and México in English or Spanish. Business Launch includes Spanish versions of key pages.

Full refund before you submit the project form, 50% refund after the form and before we deliver the first design, and no refund after the first design is delivered. Full details are on our refund policy page.
Every package includes free post-launch fixes (14 or 30 days). After that you can add a monthly Care plan for checks, edits and support, or contact us when you need something.

settings.text: Can't find your answer? Message us before you buy and we'll reply within 1 business day.
